inputs: published prior result and exact count
outputs: Stage receipts, fresh exact count, independently checked D5 certificate or explicit non-success, candidate SHA-256 and full S3 readback.

arms.description: Recheck the public D4 seed, enumerate exact solutions, stream a bounded D5 candidate to S3, read it back and feed it to the original checker.
Fresh exact count for the identical retained input; require agreement with the published zero before D5.

claims.text: An independently accepted D5 certificate whose checked codimension exceeds the fresh exact solution count certifies LFD >=6 for this named Boolean presentation.

aa.not_applicable_reason: Exact deterministic algebra and counts; no runtime comparison. Different chunk sizes are covered by software fixtures.

negative.not_applicable_reason: Changed seed, instrument, readback and producer failures are rejected in focused transport controls; no population null or statistical claim is made.

positive.not_applicable_reason: No known degree-six positive. The EKS image preflight passed a real native small-system D5 fixture with independently checked codimension 3 and full S3 readback; non-detection on n51 gives no upper bound.

decision_rule.text: Original D5 checker acceptance and exact_count < checked_codimension establishes LFD>=6 for the named input.
decision_rule.threshold: Independent D5 acceptance and exact_count < checked_codimension

placement.checkpoint_detail: No checkpoint; candidate streams directly to assigned S3 prefix, then full readback is hashed and checked. Seed and stage receipts upload before exit.

inadmissible: Calling a producer candidate certified before full readback and original checker acceptance.
Inferring LFD>=6 without accepted D5 map and strict count inequality.
Treating timeout, preemption or capacity refusal as an upper bound.
Replacing the selected published input after observing D5 output.
invalidation_rules: Any source, binary, request, seed or bundle hash mismatch prevents execution.
A failed or missing independent checker prevents LFD inference.
A missing or nonzero fresh solution count prevents the strict inequality.
A missing or changed S3 readback prevents certificate acceptance.
Resource refusal, timeout or preemption remains unknown for D5.

links.launch_gate: Qualified EKS image preflight, frozen protocol and request, immutable public bundle, no live duplicate, unique assigned result prefix, 96 GiB pod admission.

literature.claim: Degree and closure definitions and exact-count bridge for the named Boolean systems.
Constructive quotient-lift rationale and known source bounds; no runtime or novelty claim.

stopping_rules.rule: One named n51 polynomial-01 cloud attempt, no automatic retry; 21600-second Job deadline and frozen stage limits. Preserve refusal, timeout, preemption and checker failure as non-success.

variable_ledger.aa_not_applicable: Deterministic exact certificates and enumeration; no timing comparison.
